title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00109 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: POOH from 1830m to 1693m
00:15 - 01:00: Worked on load handling and slew fault on aft PRS. Reset
01:00 - 04:15: POOH with tagging BHA from 1693m to 95m
04:15 - 04:30: Flowchecked well for 15 min. Meanwhile removed ps21 and installed master bushing
04:30 - 05:00: L/d HWDP and tagging BHA
05:00 - 05:30: M/u 13 3/8 CSG cutting BHA
05:30 - 07:30: RIH w/ 13 3/8 CSG cutting BHA to 850m
07:30 - 08:00: M/u TDS, filled string, recorded parameters 97t weight up, 93t weight down, 95t free rotation w/ no flow, 100 RPM, 2-6 KNM. W/ 300 LPM 18bar, 500lpm 56bar, 600 LPM 76bar
08:00 - 08:30: Cut 13 5/8 casing 850m. 80rpm 9knm, 500lpm 56bar. Good indications of cut, heard sound on surface
08:30 - 08:45: Flow checked well for 15 min static
08:45 - 10:30: POOH from 850m to 9m. Pulled wet, used mud bucket
10:30 - 10:45: Performed pre-job meeting before l/d CSG cutter BHA
10:45 - 11:15: Changed ps21 to master bushing, l/d cutter BHA. Inspected knives, in good condition
11:15 - 11:45: Cleaned and cleared rig floor. Meanwhile changed dies on aft IR and aft PRS
11:45 - 13:00: P/u 13 3/8 EZSV and m/u same to running tool. Installed centralizer springs on running tool and m/u to stand of 5½ drill pipe
13:00 - 13:15: Removed master bushing and installed ps21 slips
13:15 - 15:00: RIH w/ EZSV plug from 43m to 842m 2min/stand
15:00 - 15:15: M/u TDS, circulated at 800lpm for 3min. Moved pipe up and down from 842mto 838m while circulating
15:15 - 15:30: Set 13 3/8 EZSV plug at 840m, sheared out of plug with 27 ton over pull and set down 6 ton to check EZSV set. Pulled up 3m and rotated 27 turns to the right to release tool
15:30 - 17:30: Circulated bottoms up 3 times. H2s gas readings on baker sensors in gas trap is MAX at 9ppm. Parameters 2500 LPM at 21 bar, 50 RPM 1-3 KNM. Observed OBM in returns. Stopped circulating with 0ppm h2s
17:30 - 17:45: R/b one stand and dropped 3 inch drift
17:45 - 18:30: POOH from 807 m to surface
18:30 - 18:45: Changed ps21 to mas

sections.text: POOH from 1830m to 1693m
Worked on load handling and slew fault on aft PRS. Reset
POOH with tagging BHA from 1693m to 95m
Flowchecked well for 15 min. Meanwhile removed ps21 and installed master bushing
L/d HWDP and tagging BHA
M/u 13 3/8 CSG cutting BHA
RIH w/ 13 3/8 CSG cutting BHA to 850m
M/u TDS, filled string, recorded parameters 97t weight up, 93t weight down, 95t free rotation w/ no flow, 100 RPM, 2-6 KNM. W/ 300 LPM 18bar, 500lpm 56bar, 600 LPM 76bar
Cut 13 5/8 casing 850m. 80rpm 9knm, 500lpm 56bar. Good indications of cut, heard sound on surface
Flow checked well for 15 min static
POOH from 850m to 9m. Pulled wet, used mud bucket
Performed pre-job meeting before l/d CSG cutter BHA
Changed ps21 to master bushing, l/d cutter BHA. Inspected knives, in good condition
Cleaned and cleared rig floor. Meanwhile changed dies on aft IR and aft PRS
P/u 13 3/8 EZSV and m/u same to running tool. Installed centralizer springs on running tool and m/u to stand of 5½ drill pipe
Removed master bushing and installed ps21 slips
RIH w/ EZSV plug from 43m to 842m 2min/stand
M/u TDS, circulated at 800lpm for 3min. Moved pipe up and down from 842mto 838m while circulating
Set 13 3/8 EZSV plug at 840m, sheared out of plug with 27 ton over pull and set down 6 ton to check EZSV set. Pulled up 3m and rotated 27 turns to the right to release tool
Circulated bottoms up 3 times. H2s gas readings on baker sensors in gas trap is MAX at 9ppm. Parameters 2500 LPM at 21 bar, 50 RPM 1-3 KNM. Observed OBM in returns. Stopped circulating with 0ppm h2s
R/b one stand and dropped 3 inch drift
POOH from 807 m to surface
Changed ps21 to master bushing
L/d EZSV running tool. Pressure tested 13 3/8in EZSV to 40 bar from above. Good test. 520 ltr pumped and 520 ltr returned
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u guns
M/u TCP guns BHA
RIH w/ gun BHA at 1 min/stand. Filled pipe, confirmed line up. Took up/down weights 73t/70t

Disconnected TDS, dropped 1,375in ball into the string, m/u TDS to the string. Closed UPR, pressured up string to fire guns. Guns fired at 120bar. Good indication of firing guns sound and light string movement. Top shot at 141,5m, bottom shot at 151,2m

Staged up pumps to 1350 LPM, circulated for 10 min, took returns through the choke. MAX h2s in returns 13 ppm on baker sensors in gas trap. Flow checked well on choke, stable. Opened upper pipe ram. Flow checked well for 10 min. Stable.
POOH w/ perforation BHA, 3x stands and 1x single
